main_text.l: fignans. Ssnstt, autem hic, ut & in plu-
ticula, idem valens ac apud nos & Sax.
nefle, & npsse, Teut. best; & hepo, in
glis, bare ; denudare, to make bare.
Fumus: sed & alio sensu, Rtecbon sun,
Sax. pec; fumare, peocan, unde no-
strum reeke, fumus: item to reeke, Belg.
nubium ex vento motum, nos racke di-
te Cœlum noœpe Sax. dictum, à mo-
vendo scil. quia semper movet: War-
than nihil aliud hic nisi verbi passivi

page.notes: Several words in the Old Saxon/Teutonic glosses are in black letter and rendered approximately; marks near "Limi" and the small marginal scribbles are illegible. Left margin and right margin contain no legible printed notes. Greek-looking Teutonic forms are approximate.
